term_types.name: Privacy mechanism family
term_types.question: Which cryptographic or structural technique provides the privacy or confidentiality guarantee?
term_types.description: The primary cryptographic or structural mechanism used to conceal data, identities, or transaction details. Refines the privacy and anonymity features node.

term_types.name: Smart contract deployment context
term_types.question: In what application context is the smart contract or script deployed?
term_types.description: Classifies the application domain or deployment setting in which the smart contract logic operates. Refines the script language expressiveness node.

term_types.name: Smart contract usage domain
term_types.question: What application domain or function is the smart contract or ledger application designed to serve?
term_types.description: Splits residual texts by the sector or function the contract or application targets, such as energy, healthcare, copyright, identity, or advertising. Refines the smart contract / distributed ledger application scope node.

term_types.name: Identity binding mechanism
term_types.question: How is a participant's identity bound to the ledger entry?
term_types.description: The mechanism linking a real-world or device identity to ledger addresses, keys, or identifiers. Refines the identity layer and onboarding node.

term_types.name: Ledger purpose
term_types.question: What is the primary purpose for which the distributed ledger is used?
term_types.description: Classifies whether the ledger records transferable value, data integrity or provenance, governance or consent, or identity and access. Refines the digital asset recording and cryptographic linkage node.

term_types.name: Ledger partitioning or layering topology
term_types.question: Is the ledger a single chain, multiple parallel or layered chains, or partitioned into sub-ledgers?
term_types.description: Describes how the ledger is divided across chains, layers, shards or partitions regardless of the underlying block or graph structure. Refines the DLT data structure node.

values.definition: Ledger identity is assigned to devices, things or digital twins rather than to human participants.

values.value: blockchain used for record-keeping of non-asset data
values.definition: Distributed ledger used to store records, logs, certificates or events rather than a transferable asset or token.
